cer_difference_95pct_interval.definition: candidate CER minus baseline CER; negative values mean fewer raw errors

limitations: All paired samples, including failed, rejected and empty predictions, remain in raw CER and exact-match denominators.
Paired-report completeness is checked against declared metrics; pass the frozen manifest to verify the intended full corpus.
Whole speakers are resampled with replacement; CER is recomputed from pooled character counts, not averaged sentence CER.
The interval assumes independent, representative speakers; few speakers or shared recording conditions limit its interpretation.
Held-out labels must not select decoding, cleanup or training; freeze the candidate before accessing a fresh test.
Statistical improvement does not establish usable silent Chinese speech, webcam performance or deployment rights.
Normalization uses NFKC/casefold letters and numbers; unknown-token literal letters remain in raw CER.

reverse_batch_validation.scope: Isolated reverse scoring, shared encoder/candidates; not end-to-end speed or CER improvement.

limitations: All clips are voiced public Chinese-LiPS recordings, not deliberate silent dictation.
Verified real webcam/everyday free conversation coverage is zero.
Unseen is relative to supplied local adaptation train/dev; base-model pretraining exposure remains unknown.
The fresh cohort excludes every previously viewed local speaker. Full-face cohort includes nine prior-test-exposed speakers.
Candidate/base differences combine a previously trained adapter and decoder settings; new batching changes computation, not recognized text quality.
Model/data licenses remain attached to original sources.
Raw references, predictions, media and weights remain local; this file contains aggregates only.
